summary: @servicetitan/tokens preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unpacks it, chmods it executable, and execFileSync-invokes the downloaded Bun binary against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled JavaScript blob written in obfuscator.io style (large numeric/character string array, rotator function that push/shifts the array to resolve strings at runtime, _0x-prefixed renamed identifiers) and is not referenced from the package's design-tokens entry point dist/all.js — its only invocation path is preinstall execution under the freshly downloaded Bun binary. setup.mjs itself is also obfuscator.io-style, with _0x-prefixed imports and per-function string-map objects indirecting the fetch/unzip/exec literals (including references to /etc/os-release for OS detection and --version handling). A design-tokens package has no build-time need for a second language runtime; the alternate-runtime-dropper shape (fetch a non-Node interpreter, then run an opaque bundled blob under it) evades Node-only install-time inspection and hands arbitrary code execution to whatever math_init.js contains on every npm install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
